nodes.title: Instruction plus what goes there
widgets_values: Write the text-to-image prompt for the finished version of this picture. The flat mid-gray areas are blank space that will be painted to continue the scene: describe what naturally fills them, never call them gray, blank, empty or padding, and don't mention any tilt. Continue the picture's own background into those areas. A plain backdrop, such as a white studio sweep, carries on in the same colour as around the subject; a room, street or landscape carries on as more of the same place. Only if the subject has no background at all, give it a fitting setting. One paragraph of 50 to 90 words. Begin with the medium and style in a few words, such as "Photograph", "Smartphone photo", "Anime illustration", "Oil painting" or "3D render". Then describe the subject, the setting, and the background from edge to edge. Include materials, colours, lighting, time of day, camera angle and framing. Quote any readable text exactly. Use plain factual language; do not start with 'The image' or 'This picture' and do not give opinions. Output only the prompt.
